presentation.summary: Summon a hunter with explosive kills and 25% less contact damage.

recipe.name: Reaping Spirit
recipe.requirements: Reach rank 8 in Seeking Spirit and Plague Seed, then choose Reaping Spirit. Both ingredients stay equipped.
recipe.description: Gain: contact kills burst for half damage within 100, without chaining. Cost: 25% less contact damage than Seeking Spirit. Strikes every 0.5 seconds for 5 seconds; up to 3 spirits. Keeps both ingredients and starts at rank 1 without using an active slot.
recipe.card_description: Gain: contact kills burst for half damage nearby. Cost: 25% less contact damage; bursts cannot chain.
